description: This file defines the 'Proxy' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. The class provides a dynamic proxy pattern to access and manipulate other objects, potentially models, in a flexible manner. It includes magic methods for property access (__get, __set), method calls (__call), and property existence (__isset, __unset). It appears to be part of the core engine of the OpenCart system, facilitating dynamic interactions with models or other components via a proxy object.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: A dynamic proxy class that forwards property and method calls to other objects, typically models, enabling flexible interactions within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a wrapped object from the internal data array by key, or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a wrapped object in the internal data array by key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a key from the internal data array.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Delegates method calls to the wrapped object if it exists; otherwise, raises an exception indicating an undefined property.
